name: Davco Trojan Mastic
paste:
DAVCO TROJAN MASTIC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco Trojan Mastic, June 2023, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/davco-trojan-mastic.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco Trojan Mastic where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Davco Trojan Mastic is an economical, white, polymer fortified cement based adhesive designs for a variety of tiles and surfaces.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Surfaces
    - Most common substrates - building boards including compressed and fibre cement sheet, fully cured concrete, screed (cured for 7 days), rendered brickwork and blockwork and compatible waterproofing membranes. Suitable for tiling over timber floors, provided that a fibre cement sheet tile underlay is first installed. Tiles
    - Ideal for large format and rectified (square) edge tiles, porcelain, ceramic, mosaic and marble tiles.
    - Areas
    - Commercial and domestic walls and floors including high foot traffic locations, bathrooms, showers, kitchens, laundries, living rooms, balconies and patios.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco Trojan Mastic
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A POLYMER FORTIFIED CEMENT BASED TILE ADHESIVE SUITABLE FOR A VARIETY OF TILES AND SURFACES.
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2023, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Trade grade
    - Extended open time for tiling large areas
    - Non-vertical slump for easy wall tiling
    - Suitable for walls & floors and interior & exterior applications
    - White formulation ideal for light coloured tiles and stone
    - Economical
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: White powder
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg bags - 64 bags per pallet
    - Shelf life: 12 Months from date of manufacture.
    - Storage conditions: Store in an elevated location in dry cool conditions.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2023, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing Ratio: 5-5.5 Litres per 20kg Bag
    - Consumption: Approximately 6-7m² per bag with a 10mm notched trowel.
    - Pot Life: 2 hours. Adhesive may need re-stirring during its pot life
    - Open Time: 30 minutes at 23°C and 50% relative humidity.
4.3 Applied Product Ready for Use.
    | Application | Wait time |
    | Grouting and light foot trafic | 24 hours |
    | Wet area service | 7 days |
    | Specifications vary according to site conditions and should be taken as a guide only. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with inclusion of movement joints, in accordance with the Australian Standards. Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles.
    - Davco Trojan Mastic is not suitable for submerged applications.
    - Davco Trojan Mastic is not suitable for applications for direct fixing over timber substrates.
    - Davco Trojan Mastic is not suitable for applications over heated substrates
    - Davco Trojan Mastic is not suitable for applications externally on facades above 3 meters in height.
4.5 Further information.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
    - For applications not mentioned in this document please contact Sika Australia.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2023, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco Trojan Mastic, June 2023, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/davco-trojan-mastic.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Trojan Mastic, version 01/10/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sds-davco-trojanmastic.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (June 2023, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
